name: hackforge
description: Hackathon and coding-challenge harness: reads a challenge/ folder, researches, scouts every kind of deliverable (code, 3D, audio, video, hardware), designs and judges options, builds in parallel worktrees under per-milestone contracts, and runs a locked-checks improvement loop with guardrails, a read-only advisor and independent graders. Integrity, guardrails and review ideas adapted from Claude Code Harness (MIT).
